description: Literals scan-release-artifact.mjs may find in a shipped bundle. Every entry states why the value is public. A provider secret never belongs here.

allowed.why: Loopback address of the Desktop browser bridge (BROWSER_BRIDGE_DEFAULT_PORT in packages/contracts/types/src/browser-bridge.ts). The Chrome extension pairs with it on the user's own machine and its manifest declares http://localhost/* for that purpose; no remote host is reachable through it.
